name: Smoked Salmon Sandwich with Lettuce, Tomato, Avocado & Chopped Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place mayo, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
Separate lettuce leaves; set aside one leaf per sandwich. Chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl.
Add broccoli slaw to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Thinly slice tomatoes and place on a plate.
Halve and pit avocados; cut crosswise while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon. Add to the plate with the tomato.
To assemble the sandwiches, spread each bread slice with additional mayo. Layer half of the slices with the reserved lettuce, tomato, avocado, and smoked salmon; close with remaining slices.
To serve, divide salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
